description_for_human: AI development ecosystem with RAG systems, multi-agent orchestration, and Cloudflare Workers deployment platform.
description_for_model: JIMBO77 Devz Inc is an advanced AI development and operations hub featuring: (1) PUMO RAG - hybrid search system for furniture e-commerce using Cloudflare Vectorize + DeepSeek R1; (2) Multi-agent orchestration with 18 specialized AI agents for deployment, monitoring, cost optimization; (3) MCP servers for VS Code integration including workspace navigation, RAG memory, semantic code analysis; (4) Technical blog (MyBonzo AI Blog) with Astro + Cloudflare Pages; (5) Privacy-first browser interface (Zen Browser OS). All projects use Cloudflare Workers for edge deployment, with PostgreSQL/Redis data layer and Docker-based development environment. Use this plugin to discover project details, API endpoints, architecture patterns, and implementation examples.
